name: HardSoftRas Blending
definition: A blending function that distinguishes between edge pixels (silhouettes/vertical surfaces) and non-edge pixels. It uses weighted averaging for edges and keeps the most frontal color for non-edges, generalizing anti-aliasing and SoftRas.
summary: HardSoftRas Blending is a differentiable rendering technique that preserves sharp internal textures by using frontal colors for non-edge pixels while applying probabilistic blending only at silhouettes.
